rationale.exclude_record: no clearly localized visible fire is covered at full source resolution; exclusion is safer than relabelling ambiguous video frames as background
rationale.filter_boxes: retain boxes covering visible flame while removing smoke-only regions, broadcast graphics, vehicle lights, boundary artifacts, and redundant ambiguous fragments

interpretation: All actions create a new derived manifest and leave original images, labels, and version-5 records unchanged.
Legitimate fire-free hard negatives remain in the dataset; only erroneous or ambiguous positive annotations are removed.
The adjudication is single-reviewer and the stratified queue is not a prevalence sample.
